include_directories(../include ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dependencies/include)

foreach(_H_FILE ${HEADERS})
    get_filename_component(_H_FILE "${_H_FILE}" ABSOLUTE)
    file(RELATIVE_PATH _H_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.." ${_H_FILE})
    configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../${_H_FILE}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dependencies/${_H_FILE}" COPYONLY)
endforeach()

configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include/ft2build.h" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dependencies/include/ft2build.h" COPYONLY)

configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../docs/LICENSE.TXT" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dependencies/freetype-license.txt" COPYONLY)

cegui_add_library(${DEPNAME} SOURCES NONE)

if (WIN32)
    set_target_properties(${DEPNAME} PROPERTIES
        DEFINE_SYMBOL "FT2_BUILD_LIBRARY"
        COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS")
endif()

set_target_properties(${DEPNAME} PROPERTIES
    IMPORT_PREFIX ""
    PREFIX ""
    COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "FT2_BUILD_LIBRARY")

set_target_properties(${DEPNAME}_static PROPERTIES
    PREFIX ""
    COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "FT2_BUILD_LIBRARY")

get_property(ALL_TARGETS DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" PROPERTY BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
foreach(TARGET_NAME IN LISTS ALL_TARGETS)
    target_include_directories(${TARGET_NAME}
        PUBLIC
            ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dependencies
        PRIVATE
            ../include
    )
endforeach()
